production_error_rate.note: Measured on captured production traffic, not on a draw from data/processed/test.csv. Only interpretable if the CS tool posts confirmations as well as disputes: a confirmation (model_label == corrected_label) is the denominator, and a tool that posts only disputes makes this number uninterpretable.

caveat: There is no deployed service or CS tool yet, so every value here is a rehearsal until real traffic arrives. Two-agent corroboration also needs a roster with at least two real agent ids: until one exists every row is `single_agent` and nothing is trainable.
